# recsim.user.AbstractUserSampler

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api_docs.py; do not edit. -->

```python
recsim.user.AbstractUserSampler(user_ctor, seed=0)
```

Abstract class to sample users.

## Methods

### `get_user_ctor(self)`

Returns the constructor/class of the user states that will be sampled.

### `reset_sampler(self, seed=None)`

Reseeds this sampler; omitted seed replays its configured stream.

### `sample_user(self)`

Creates a new instantiation of this user's hidden state parameters.

Returns:
  An instance of AbstractUserState (or a subclass).
